features.quote: the cemetery to have been in a rocky ledge 0.5 mile north

notes: f1: text puts the pool on the western slope (plan fig. 167, north arrow pointing left, shows it on the W/SW slope; words used). f3-f4: Guerin's wali is 'some distance west, at the tell's foot'; the Muslim tombs are in its forecourt, so given the same W direction. f5: the quoted British Survey says the town stood at Tell el Mazar (which the entry equates with this tell) and the cemetery was 0.5 mile (= 805 m) north; relative_to unit. Grave type not stated, so cavity_with_opening false. WBADB row S1080 'Tell el-Mazar' (922 m, 347.5 deg) lists a Per cemetery, but the entry does not link the two, so no grid position. CONFLICT: the data block says 'Cisterns: none' (recorded as a C2 absence), but the quoted 1874 survey reports ruined cemented cisterns on the tell (f2). The Abel quote's sarcophagus in a quarry belongs to Site 82 and is not coded.
